subject: Computer Networks

questions.chapter: Network Reference Models (OSI & TCP/IP)
questions.text: Compare the 7-layer OSI Reference Model with the 5-layer TCP/IP Reference Model. Explain the primary functions, data protocol units (PDU), and prominent protocols operating at each layer.

questions.chapter: Network Reference Models (OSI & TCP/IP)
questions.text: Differentiate between Circuit Switching, Packet Switching (Datagram vs Virtual Circuit), and Message Switching in terms of connection setup delay, transmission overhead, bandwidth efficiency, and fault tolerance.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer, Framing, Error Control & Flow Control
questions.text: Explain Framing techniques: (a) Character Count, (b) Byte Stuffing (Flag byte with ESC), and (c) Bit Stuffing (Flag `01111110` with zero stuffing after five consecutive 1s). Stuff the payload `0111111011111001` using bit stuffing.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer, Framing, Error Control & Flow Control
questions.text: Explain Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) error detection. A message bit stream $1101011011$ is to be transmitted using generator polynomial $G(x) = x^4 + x + 1$. Find the transmitted CRC codeword and verify error detection when the third bit from left is corrupted during transmission.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer, Framing, Error Control & Flow Control
questions.text: Explain Sliding Window Flow Control protocols: (a) Stop-and-Wait ARQ, (b) Go-Back-N ARQ, and (c) Selective Repeat ARQ. Derive formulas for channel utilization and maximum sender window size for Go-Back-N ($N = 2^k - 1$) and Selective Repeat ($N = 2^{k-1}$).

questions.chapter: Medium Access Control Sublayer & IEEE 802 Standards
questions.text: Explain Pure ALOHA vs. Slotted ALOHA random access protocols. Derive the throughput equations $S = G e^{-2G}$ for Pure ALOHA ($S_{max} = \frac{1}{2e} \approx 18.4\%$) and $S = G e^{-G}$ for Slotted ALOHA ($S_{max} = \frac{1}{e} \approx 36.8\%$).

questions.chapter: Medium Access Control Sublayer & IEEE 802 Standards
questions.text: Explain CSMA Protocols (1-persistent, Non-persistent, $p$-persistent CSMA). Explain CSMA/CD in Ethernet and CSMA/CA with RTS/CTS handshake in IEEE 802.11 Wireless LANs (Solving Hidden Terminal and Exposed Terminal problems).

questions.chapter: Medium Access Control Sublayer & IEEE 802 Standards
questions.text: In a $10\,\text{Mbps}$ CSMA/CD standard Ethernet network with cable length $2.5\,\text{km}$ and signal propagation speed $2 \times 10^8\,\text{m/s}$, derive the minimum frame size requirement: $L_{min} = 2 \times R \times T_p = 64\,\text{bytes}$. Explain Binary Exponential Backoff algorithm.

questions.chapter: Network Layer, IP Addressing, Subnetting & Routing
questions.text: An organization is assigned the Class C network block $192.168.10.0/24$. Design a Variable Length Subnet Mask (VLSM) scheme to create 4 subnets: Subnet A with 60 hosts, Subnet B with 28 hosts, Subnet C with 12 hosts, and Subnet D with 2 hosts. Specify subnet mask (CIDR), network address, usable IP range, and broadcast address for each subnet.

questions.chapter: Network Layer, IP Addressing, Subnetting & Routing
questions.text: Explain Distance Vector Routing based on Bellman-Ford algorithm. What is the Count-to-Infinity problem and how is it mitigated using Split Horizon and Poison Reverse? Trace distance vector table updates for a 4-node network when a link fails.

questions.chapter: Network Layer, IP Addressing, Subnetting & Routing
questions.text: Explain Link State Routing based on Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm. Describe Link State Advertisements (LSA) and flooding in Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) routing protocol. Compare OSPF vs RIP vs BGP.

questions.chapter: Network Layer, IP Addressing, Subnetting & Routing
questions.text: Explain the working of: (a) Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) and Inverse ARP, (b) Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP - DORA process), (c) Network Address Translation (NAT/PAT), and (d) Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP ping & traceroute).

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain TCP 3-Way Handshake connection establishment (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) and 4-way connection teardown (FIN, ACK, FIN, ACK) with sequence numbers and timing diagrams. Differentiate between TCP and UDP headers.

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain TCP Congestion Control mechanisms in detail: Slow Start (Exponential increase), Congestion Avoidance (Additive Increase), Fast Retransmit (Triple duplicate ACKs), and Fast Recovery (Multiplicative Decrease - AIMD). Draw the Congestion Window ($cwnd$) growth curve.

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain Domain Name System (DNS) architecture (Hierarchical domain tree, Root servers, TLD servers, Authoritative servers, Recursive vs Iterative resolution, and DNS caching). Explain HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 (Multiplexing, header compression), and HTTP/3 (QUIC over UDP).

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain RSA Public Key Cryptography. In an RSA cryptosystem with prime numbers $p = 7, q = 11$, and public encryption exponent $e = 13$: (a) Calculate modulus $n = pq$ and Euler's totient $\phi(n) = (p-1)(q-1)$, (b) Determine private decryption key $d$ using Extended Euclidean algorithm, (c) Encrypt plaintext message $M = 9$, and (d) Decrypt ciphertext $C$ back to $M$.

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain Digital Signatures and Public Key Certificates (X.509 standard). Explain SSL/TLS protocol architecture and the secure HTTPS connection establishment.

questions.chapter: Network Reference Models (OSI & TCP/IP)
questions.text: Explain Transmission Impairments in physical media: Attenuation, Distortion, and Noise (Thermal, Intermodulation, Crosstalk, Impulse noise). State Nyquist Bit Rate formula ($C = 2B \log_2 M$) and Shannon Capacity formula ($C = B \log_2(1 + SNR)$).

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer, Framing, Error Control & Flow Control
questions.text: Explain Hamming Code for single error correction and double error detection. Generate the 7-bit Hamming code for data word $1011$ with even parity. Correct the received corrupted codeword $1001011$.

questions.chapter: Medium Access Control Sublayer & IEEE 802 Standards
questions.text: Explain Virtual LAN (VLAN - IEEE 802.1Q frame tagging), Spanning Tree Protocol (STP - IEEE 802.1D for bridge loop prevention), and differences between Hubs, Layer-2 Switches, and Routers.

questions.chapter: Network Layer, IP Addressing, Subnetting & Routing
questions.text: Compare IPv4 Header vs IPv6 Header. Explain IPv6 address representations, Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), and IPv4-to-IPv6 transition strategies (Dual-Stack, Tunneling, and NAT64).

questions.chapter: Transport & Application Layers, TCP Protocols & Security
questions.text: Explain Email Protocols: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP), Post Office Protocol (POP3), and Internet Message Access Protocol (IMAP). Explain MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions).
